answer: Vertex graph audit keeps sybils out. Every alias is a vertex, and an edge forms only when two aliases finish a real job together. Each finished job drops a marble into the alias's public jar, and a vertex needs 12 marbles from 6 neighbors before it can bid above 3 POA. A sybil farm shows up as a tight clique with many edges inside and almost none reaching the honest graph. Peers run a cut check each epoch and flag any cluster where over 80 percent of edges stay inside and under 2 reach outside. A flagged cluster drops to nadir standing, loses its pay, and freezes for 21 epochs.
